name: Cash Prize to Players and their Coaches for Winning Medals in National and International Competitions
benefit:
- Under this scheme, athletes who achieve significant success at the national and international levels, along with their coaches, are awarded cash prizes. 
  - There is a provision to award prize money ranging from a minimum of ₹10,000/- to a maximum of ₹2 crore.  - Detailed information about the awards is available on the department&#39;s website: [https://sports.uk.gov.in](https://sports.uk.
_eligibility_text: 1. Players and their coaches from Uttarakhand who have achieved remarkable success at the national and international levels in the field of sports are eligible.
